key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:25F8
name: countdown_tick_and_realign_heading
description: Decrements a frame countdown in the object record and, when it expires, copies a stored value into the current position field, then re-aims the heading only if the difference from a reference value lies in a mid-range band.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2632
name: spawn_pooled_object_node
description: Takes a node from a pooled free list, links it into the active list, and fills it with the caller's position, speed and frame-table entries, then sets two of its handler fields to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2702
name: roll_jittered_random_byte
description: Reads two random values and returns a byte, adding a centred random offset of about minus 32 to plus 31 when a flag in the caller's record is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2726
name: set_random_heading_and_countdown
description: Chooses a new heading from a random value plus a small centred offset, arms a countdown of seven, saves the current update handler and installs the next one, then clears a state field.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:277C
name: nearest_target_squared_distance
description: Picks one of two candidate objects based on the sign of a stored value and, when both are active, returns the squared distance from the caller to that candidate; otherwise it returns a stored fallback or zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:27D4
name: check_circular_collision
description: Adds the two objects' radius fields and returns all ones when both axis offsets are below that sum and the squared distance is below the squared sum, otherwise returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:280E
name: return_constant_zero
description: A two-instruction routine that only returns zero, used where a callback must report no result.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2812
name: steer_heading_toward_target
description: When the target lies within a small angular window it records the target and arms the next handler; otherwise it halves two motion accumulators, switches the handler, turns the heading by 64 steps toward the target side, and folds the accumulator back to a two-bit value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:283C
name: turn_heading_toward_target
description: Tests whether the target lies within a small angular window; if so it records the target and arms the next handler, otherwise it halves two accumulators, switches the handler, turns the heading 64 steps toward the target side, and folds the accumulator back to two bits.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2874
name: advance_countdown_or_steer
description: With the earlier comparison flag set it halves two accumulators, switches the handler and turns toward the target; otherwise it counts a timer down and, on expiry, reloads it and either picks a new heading or moves to the next state.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2886
name: reload_countdown_and_pick_state
description: Counts a timer down and on expiry reloads it from its stored reset value; if the state is zero it resets a field, picks a new heading and sets the state to five, otherwise it sets the state to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:288E
name: reload_timer_and_toggle_state
description: Reloads the countdown from its stored reset value, then toggles the state: a zero state gets a freshly chosen heading and the value five, while any other state is cleared to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:28B2
name: randomize_heading_within_spread
description: Reads a heading from a called routine and, when a flag on the other object is set, adds a random offset from minus 64 to plus 63 and wraps the result to a byte before storing it as the object's heading.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:28D6
name: decay_scale_and_check_proximity
description: Scales a stored magnitude down by a fixed factor each tick and stores its square; when the countdown expires it checks whether the squared distance to the other object is under 102400, calls a routine if so, resets the heading, quadruples two accumulators and switches the handler, otherwise it turns toward the target.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:28F2
name: check_proximity_and_quadruple_accumulators
description: On countdown expiry it compares the squared distance to the other object with 102400, calls a routine when close, reloads the heading, quadruples two accumulators and installs the next handler; otherwise it turns toward the target.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:292E
name: close_range_check_and_quadruple
description: On countdown expiry it compares the squared distance to the other object with 65536, calls a routine when close, reloads the heading, quadruples two accumulators and installs the next handler; otherwise it turns toward the target.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2968
name: countdown_reset_heading_quadruple
description: Counts a timer down and, on expiry, takes a new heading from a called routine, quadruples two accumulators and installs the next handler; otherwise it turns toward the target by a fixed step.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:29A0
name: track_heading_and_arm_timer
description: Saves the current heading, turns toward the target each tick while the countdown runs and calls a routine every 32 ticks; on expiry it clears the state, arms a one-tick countdown, loads a delay from its reset field and installs the next handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:29CA
name: arm_one_tick_countdown
description: Clears the state, sets a one-tick countdown, loads a delay from the object's reset field and installs the next update handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:29E4
name: countdown_heading_and_second_timer
description: Counts a timer down and on expiry reloads it, sets a new heading from a called routine, and counts a second delay down, installing the next handler once that second delay expires.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2A38
name: advance_table_phase_and_move
description: Advances a phase counter by eight and sets a vertical offset from a lookup table minus 32, then runs a countdown that on expiry sets a flag and a drift accumulator; it adds two velocity values to the position and clears the accumulator once it passes two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2ADE
name: pick_animation_frame_on_phase
description: Sets a state of five or zero from bit two of a phase counter and, when the low three bits reach seven, calls a routine with an entry from a data table indexed by the upper bits; on countdown expiry it restores the saved handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2B4A
name: turn_toward_target_then_rearm
description: Steps the heading toward the target side each tick while the countdown runs; on expiry it takes a new heading from a called routine, sets the countdown to 39, saves the current handler and installs the next one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2B7A
name: spawn_pooled_node_after_countdown
description: While the countdown runs it steers the heading toward the target; when it ends it picks a new heading, arms a seven-tick countdown, sets the state to five, and spawns a pooled node with a fixed parameter of 20 and velocities taken from a lookup table scaled by 40.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2BCA
name: advance_phase_for_table_offset
description: Advances a phase counter by four and sets a vertical offset from a lookup table minus 48.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2BEE
name: match_heading_and_set_velocity
description: If the heading is within 16 of a called value it adopts that value, installs the next handler and derives two velocity components from a table entry; otherwise it advances the heading by 128 and by a stored state offset.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2C20
name: offset_heading_by_state
description: Adds 128 to the heading, adds a stored state offset to it, and passes the result to a called routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2C38
name: bounce_accumulator_in_range
description: Adds the step accumulator to a running value and, when that value leaves the band from 32768 to 163839, subtracts the step and negates the step so the value bounces back.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2C60
name: align_heading_and_arm_countdown
description: When the heading is within 128 of a called value it calls a routine and nudges the heading by 128 unless the gap is exactly 128; it then installs the next handler, sets the accumulator to 32768 and loads the countdown from a stored delay plus a called value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2C88
name: offset_heading_and_arm_countdown
description: Adds 128 to the heading, installs the next handler, sets the accumulator to 32768 and loads the countdown from a stored delay plus a called value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2CA2
name: randomize_heading_and_restart_countdown
description: Steers toward the target while the countdown runs; when it expires it sets the heading to a called value plus an offset from minus 16 to plus 15, calls a routine, reloads the countdown with seven and installs the next handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2D04
name: spawn_pooled_node_periodically
description: Counts a timer below zero and, once it passes minus 127, sets a fixed state value of 47; on every eighth tick it spawns a pooled node with fixed parameters including 27 and 16 and velocities taken from a lookup table scaled by 32.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2D1E
name: spawn_pooled_node_returning_velocity
description: On every eighth tick, if the pool has a free node, it spawns a node with fixed field values and table-derived velocities, and returns the x velocity term to the caller.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2E0A
name: dispatch_through_stored_handler
description: Calls a routine and then jumps through a function pointer held in a data cell, forwarding control to whichever handler is currently installed.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2E12
name: step_frame_velocity_accumulators
description: When the zero flag is set it looks up a table entry, adds four times its two components to the velocity accumulators while their magnitude stays under 2097152, then advances a frame counter that wraps at a limit read from the record; otherwise it jumps through a stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2E66
name: accumulate_wrap_two_bit_state
description: Adds the step accumulator into a running value and keeps only its low two bits.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2E76
name: random_sign_step_of_four
description: When a stored step is unset, it takes a random bit and stores a step of plus four or minus four, then returns the stored step.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2E90
name: track_heading_and_update_velocity
description: Compares the heading with a called value using a window of six when the flag at offset 18 is set and twenty-four when it is clear; inside the window it clears the flag and returns, otherwise it moves the heading toward the value, and in both cases recomputes two velocity components from a table entry scaled by a speed field.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2EAC
name: turn_heading_when_gap_large
description: If the gap between the heading and a called value reaches the window (six when the flag at offset 18 is set, otherwise twenty-four), it adds the called value to the heading and recomputes two velocity components; otherwise it clears the flag and calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2ED8
name: clear_flag_and_call_routine
description: When the flag at offset 18 is set it clears the flag and calls a routine; otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2EF0
name: spawn_timed_child_on_expiry
description: Advances a phase counter and derives a vertical offset from a table; when its countdown expires and the pool has a free node it spawns a child with copies of the position, installs its handlers, and sets a new countdown between 15 and 30 from a random value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2FC0
name: recompute_velocity_from_heading
description: Looks up a table entry for the current heading and sets the two velocity accumulators from its components scaled by the speed field.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:2FEE
name: apply_velocity_conditionally
description: Moves the position by the two velocity accumulators, using a zero test on the vertical result and a called check to decide whether to commit the new horizontal and vertical values or keep the previous ones.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3014
name: store_position_from_registers
description: Calls a routine and then stores the two register-passed values into the object's position fields.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3026
name: advance_shared_state_on_expiry
description: Counts a timer down; on expiry it either sets the global state counter to two, or, when the shared mode is two, sets a second counter to four and flags both records for update.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:305C
name: check_partner_flag_then_advance
description: If the record's own flag is set it only installs the handler; otherwise it installs the handler and, when the shared counter is nonzero and the partner record's flag is clear, sets the global state counter to two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:306C
name: install_handler_and_advance_state
description: Installs the handler, and unless the partner record's flag is set, sets the global state counter to two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3086
name: advance_state_unless_flagged
description: Calls a routine and, unless the record's flag is set, sets the global state counter to two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3092
name: copy_template_and_activate_record
description: When the flag test passes it copies forty words from one of two source records into the object's working block, resets its counters to 75 and zero, loads its starting position from the template, pops a free entry from a list and marks the record for update.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:31D6
name: return_without_action
description: A single return instruction, so calling it does nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:31E4
name: set_secondary_target_slot
description: Stores a pointer to a shared data block in the record and sets its slot count to two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:31F4
name: mark_active_when_flagged
description: If a referenced record's value at offset 42 is nonzero, it sets the record's active flag to minus one and calls a routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3204
name: reset_record_idle_handler
description: Calls a routine, clears two counters and a field, sets the active flag to minus one and installs a fixed idle handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:338A
name: cycle_four_entry_table_value
description: Increments a frame counter and loads a value from a four-entry data table selected by bits one and two of that counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3558
name: copy_table_pair_by_index
description: Copies two longwords from the table entry selected by a record field, scaled by eight, into a pair of shared globals.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:35D8
name: copy_table_pair_by_slot
description: Copies two longwords from the table entry selected by a record field, scaled by eight, into a pair of shared globals; the code is identical to its neighbour and is reached from a different call site.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:35DC
name: copy_table_pair_by_entry
description: Copies two longwords from the table entry selected by a record field, scaled by eight, into a pair of shared globals; the code is identical to its neighbours.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:35F6
name: ramp_and_decay_velocity_term
description: While a shared target value is nonzero it ramps a velocity term by steps of 131072 or 262144 toward plus or minus 262144 and clamps it there; when the target is zero it decays the term toward zero in steps of 131072, adding the term into an accumulator and returning it.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3642
name: set_full_term_and_accumulate
description: Sets a velocity term to 262144 and adds it into its accumulator.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:364C
name: decay_term_toward_zero
description: Decays a velocity term toward zero in steps of 131072, adds it into its accumulator, and zeroes the term when a step would overshoot.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3664
name: step_term_down_and_accumulate
description: Subtracts 131072 from a velocity term; if the result is negative it zeroes the term, otherwise it adds the term into its accumulator.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:37FC
name: set_position_from_scaled_table
description: For the primary record it computes a target position from a table entry scaled by 25 and two register inputs, and commits it to the position only when a called check passes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3800
name: commit_scaled_table_position
description: Uses the same logic as its neighbour: for the primary record it computes a table-scaled target position from two register inputs and stores it only when a called check passes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:383C
name: store_position_longwords
description: Stores the two register-passed longwords into the object's position fields with no checks.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:39FE
name: scale_offset_by_negated_input
description: Returns a pair of values, each the negated input multiplied by one of two record fields and by two.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A14
name: call_two_update_steps
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A20
name: latch_nonzero_global_once
description: Returns a shared value; if it is zero it clears the latch field and returns zero, and if it is nonzero while the latch is clear it stores the value in the latch and returns it, otherwise it returns zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A32
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero and does no other work.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A36
name: clear_latch_field
description: Sets the latch field at offset 98 to zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A3C
name: step_coupled_motion_until_settled
description: Repeatedly advances a pair of coupled motion values using two coefficients from a shared table, recomputing the velocity accumulators each step, until the velocity settles to zero or the step counter at offset 92 runs out; then it advances the frame counter with wrap.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3A4E
name: step_coupled_motion_then_dispatch
description: Runs the same coupled-motion step as its neighbour and returns once the velocity settles; if the step counter runs out first it jumps through the stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3AAA
name: step_coupled_motion_while_moving
description: Calls a routine, then keeps stepping the coupled motion values while the velocity is nonzero, advancing the frame counter once it settles; if the step budget runs out it dispatches through the stored handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3ACA
name: cull_near_objects_in_list
description: Walks a linked list of active objects, advancing each one's position by its velocity and a sub-step accumulator; objects that come within a squared distance of 4096 of a reference object are unlinked and returned to the free pool.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3B5E
name: render_visible_object_cells
description: Scans a list of active objects, projects each one onto two basis vectors and writes a masked row word into a frame buffer table for objects inside the visible window, and writes a control word to the interrupt-enable hardware register.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3CB2
name: insert_visible_draw_entry
description: Projects the object's offset from a reference point and, when it lies in range, takes a node from the draw pool and inserts it into a list sorted by depth so drawing happens in order.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3CC6
name: insert_sorted_draw_entry_fixed
description: Works like its neighbour in the draw list, but stores a fixed value of 512 in the entry instead of the caller's field.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3CDA
name: insert_draw_entry_by_angle
description: Inserts a projected entry into the depth-sorted draw list, choosing the frame index from the offset between the heading and a called value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3D0C
name: insert_draw_entry_from_registers
description: Inserts a depth-sorted draw entry built from register-passed position and offset values, using the same range check and sorted insertion as its neighbours.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3D86
name: scan_cells_with_frame_stamp
description: Walks a grid of cells covering a rectangle, stamps each newly visited cell with the current frame stamp, and when a called routine returns a value below the record's threshold it returns a negative flag.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3D8E
name: advance_frame_stamp_and_clear
description: Increments a frame stamp counter and, when it wraps to zero, clears the stamp table and bumps the counter again.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3DE2
name: scan_grid_cells_for_threshold
description: Walks grid cells in a rectangle, stamping each visited cell, and returns a negative flag as soon as a called routine's result falls below the record's threshold; it works like its neighbour but in a different loop order.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3E50
name: fill_grid_cells_until_threshold
description: Walks a row of grid cells inside a rectangle, writing a fixed value into each cell that differs and calling a routine per cell, and returns a flag once that routine's result drops below the record's threshold.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3E62
name: find_cell_distance_flag
description: Walks grid cells near a point, calls a routine for entries in occupied cells and then walks a linked list, returning a negative flag when the stored minimum falls below the record's threshold.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3E66
name: check_cell_list_minimum
description: Has the same code as its neighbour: it scans grid cells and a linked list for the minimum distance value and returns a negative flag when it falls below the record's threshold.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3EF0
name: compare_minimum_against_threshold
description: Returns the stored minimum value minus the record's threshold field, with a negative flag when the minimum is smaller.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3F0A
name: update_nearest_candidate_record
description: Stores a new value in a candidate record and, when its projected distance is below its threshold and smaller than the current minimum, records it as the new minimum candidate.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3F64
name: project_candidate_offset
description: Projects the offset from a candidate record onto a direction pair; when the first projection is under its threshold it returns a large sentinel of 16383, otherwise it returns the absolute value of the other projection.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3F8A
name: absolute_projection_of_offset
description: Returns the absolute value of the offset projected onto a direction pair, packed into both halves of a longword.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:3FF2
name: load_view_basis_for_object
description: Copies the object's position and a table-derived offset into shared globals and loads the two basis vectors for its heading and its opposite heading from a lookup table.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4066
name: decode_two_bit_direction
description: Derives a direction code from an input word: it returns minus one, one or zero depending on which two bits are set after a shift-and-XOR comparison.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4072
name: test_direction_bits_only
description: Tests two bits of the input word and returns without changing anything, so it has no observable effect.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:408A
name: read_mouse_port_input_record
description: Stores the first mouse port's movement word and two button flags, taken from bits of a shared input status word, into a four-word input record.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:40BA
name: read_joystick_port_input_record
description: Stores the second port's joystick movement word and two fire-button flags, taken from bits of a shared input status word, into a four-word input record using the same layout as its neighbour.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:40EA
name: poll_mouse_buttons_scan
description: Reads the first mouse port's movement word, then polls the fire-button and potentiometer control registers in a loop to set direction and button flags in an input record, and reconfigures the button output lines before returning.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4172
name: shift_bit_into_input_flags
description: Returns the input word shifted right by one; when its lowest bit is set it writes one into the first input field and minus one into the fourth.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4182
name: poll_joystick_buttons_scan
description: Reads the second port's movement word and polls its button bits in a loop to set direction and button flags, reconfiguring the button output lines before returning.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:41E4
name: decode_input_state_flags
description: Converts bits of a button and direction state record into four signed input words: direction from bits seven and six, then two direction words and two button flags from the remaining status bits.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:43F0
name: sort_overlapping_cell_pairs
description: Visits grid cells in a rectangle, collects their object entries and orders overlapping pairs with a cross-product test, linking the result into an output list for a later pass.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:459A
name: insert_clipped_edge_record
description: Projects a segment's two endpoints onto the view basis, rejects it when an end is out of range, computes clipped bounds from a division, and links the resulting record into the draw list.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:45F6
name: insert_clipped_span_record
description: Projects a pair of points onto the view basis and, when visible, computes horizontal clip bounds by division and links a span record into the draw list; it is similar to its neighbour but tests the endpoints in a different order.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4732
name: build_scanline_span_table
description: Scans the draw list for each scanline in a range, finds the nodes that cross the line, computes a pattern index and per-line slope terms, and writes them into a per-line table; lines with no entries receive a sentinel value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4890
name: insert_pool_node_by_key
description: Takes a node from the pool, fills its key and two fields from the register inputs, and links it into the sorted list at the position its key fits.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:48E4
name: prepare_blit_parameters_from_record
description: Toggles between two buffers in a record and copies its pointers, row modulo values and size fields into shared globals used by the blitter setup routine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4962
name: dispatch_visible_nodes_to_handlers
description: Walks a linked list of objects, projects each one that has a shape pointer, skips those whose projected screen extents fall outside the clip limits, and calls each visible object's own handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4AB2
name: dim_masked_plane_pixels
description: Walks rows of destination words and, for each nonzero source byte, halves the four-bit colour groups by ANDing with a mask that keeps bits one to three of each group and shifting right by one.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4B00
name: blend_plane_pixels_with_table
description: Blends each destination word with a colour from a lookup table by adding the masked values and halving them, skipping sources whose byte is zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4B58
name: copy_table_colour_into_plane
description: Writes a colour looked up from a table into each destination word whose source byte is nonzero; when the source is off-range and a flag is set it calls a routine to fetch the next span.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4B70
name: copy_table_colour_across_rows
description: Writes table-looked-up colours into destination words for every nonzero source byte across a run of rows, moving to the next span whenever the run ends.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4BAE
name: write_masked_nibble_column
description: Writes a four-bit masked colour value into each row of a column for nonzero source bytes.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4BE6
name: run_blitter_for_object_rows
description: Waits until the blitter is idle, then programs its source and destination pointers, modulo values, first and last word masks, control and size registers for each object row, using lookup tables for the row addresses.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4D14
name: copy_colour_or_mask_plane
description: Across a run of rows, writes a table-looked-up colour into destination words where the source byte is nonzero and ANDs the destination with a fixed mask word where the source is zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:4DBA
name: spin_forever_idle_loop
description: Loops forever without doing any work, so once entered it never returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5A10
name: call_handler_when_index_high
description: Compares a word from a table entry with 635 and, when it is larger, calls through a stored function pointer; otherwise it does nothing.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5A30
name: call_handler_index_high_ext
description: Begins with the same test as its neighbour, calling through a stored pointer when a table word exceeds 635; the rest of its body is not recovered in the pseudo-code.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5CB0
name: clear_cache_when_index_high
description: Calls the operating system's cache-clear routine through a stored function pointer when a table word exceeds 635, otherwise it returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5F40
name: damp_velocity_spawn_effect
description: Moves a shared velocity value toward zero or a bound depending on a direction and timing input, advances a phase counter, and when a called value is nonzero spawns an effect record from a pool of three slots.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5F58
name: update_dampened_velocity_with_effect
description: Performs the same velocity update and effect spawn as its neighbour, from the same shared state.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5F8E
name: reduce_velocity_and_spawn_effect
description: Lowers a shared velocity value by a fixed step, advances a phase counter, and when a called value is nonzero spawns an effect record from the three-slot pool.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5F9A
name: raise_velocity_and_spawn_effect
description: Clears a direction flag, raises a shared velocity value by a fixed step with a clamp, advances a phase counter, and spawns an effect record from the three-slot pool when a called value is nonzero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5FC4
name: nudge_velocity_and_spawn_effect
description: Adds a fixed step to a shared velocity value, advances a phase counter, and when a called value is nonzero spawns an effect record from the three-slot pool.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:5FD0
name: decay_velocity_and_spawn_effect
description: Steps a shared velocity value by a fixed amount toward zero, advances a phase counter, and when a called value is nonzero spawns an effect record from a pool of three slots.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6036
name: spawn_effect_when_flagged
description: Sets a phase counter to one and, when a called value is nonzero and the pending flag is clear, spawns an effect record from the three-slot pool and returns the spawned value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:60D0
name: clear_stored_handler
description: Clears the stored function pointer so that no handler runs on the next call.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:60D8
name: update_effect_particles_and_cull
description: Advances an effect particle's position and phase; once a counter field reaches thirty-six it unlinks the particle, calls the handlers of the remaining entries and returns.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6102
name: step_effect_particle_lifetime
description: Steps an effect particle's countdown at offset 26; while it is running the particle advances its position and returns, and on expiry it unlinks the particle and calls the handlers of the remaining entries.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6122
name: burst_eight_effect_particles
description: Spawns eight effect particles from the pool, each with velocities taken from a table and a fixed life value of fifteen, then runs the effect list handlers and updates the shared burst countdown.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:61AC
name: burst_thirty_two_effect_particles
description: Calls a routine three times, spawns thirty-two particles from the pool with velocities from a table, sets the shared burst flag to minus one and decrements a shared burst counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6242
name: step_burst_counter_and_drag
description: Decrements a per-entry counter and returns while it is still running; on expiry it runs the shared burst update, which damps velocity toward a target and spawns particles from the pool when nearby entries are found.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:624A
name: damp_burst_particle_velocity
description: Sets the particle's phase fields and, while the shared burst flag is negative, steers its two velocity terms by fixed steps toward a target and advances its position; otherwise it runs the shared burst update.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6258
name: spawn_burst_near_effect_entries
description: When the shared burst flag is clear, checks the particle against nearby effect entries and, if close, spawns up to thirty-two burst particles from the pool before running the shared burst update; when the flag is set it steers the particle toward its target as its neighbour does.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:62C0
name: steer_particle_velocity_toward_target
description: Adjusts a particle's horizontal velocity by a fixed step of 16384 according to which side of a reference value its coordinate lies, clamps it, and adds it to the position; the vertical velocity is adjusted by 8192 the same way and clamped before being applied.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:62EE
name: reduce_particle_velocity_and_step
description: Reduces the horizontal velocity by a fixed step with a lower clamp and applies it to the position, then steers the vertical velocity by a step chosen from a reference comparison and applies that too.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:633C
name: reduce_vertical_velocity_and_step
description: Lowers the vertical velocity by a fixed step of 8192 with a lower clamp and adds it to the vertical position.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6360
name: age_particle_release_on_expiry
description: Counts a particle's life down; while it remains positive it adds its velocity to the position, and on expiry it unlinks the particle, calls the handlers of the remaining entries and runs the shared burst update.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6376
name: release_particle_burst_update
description: Unlinks the particle, calls the handlers of the remaining effect entries and runs the shared burst update, which may spawn particles when nearby entries are found and decrements its countdown.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:639E
name: reset_effect_pool_and_state
description: Copies two shared values, returns every active effect entry to the free list, clears the burst position, velocity and flag globals, and sets the countdown to eighteen.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:63DA
name: clear_burst_state_and_countdown
description: Clears the burst position, velocity and flag globals and sets the burst countdown to eighteen.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:657E
name: run_effect_handlers_burst
description: Calls the handler of every effect entry in the list, then runs the shared burst update, which decrements the burst countdown and spawns particles when the flag is negative.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:65B2
name: run_shared_burst_update_bare
description: Runs the shared burst update: it decrements the flag and countdown and, when the counter reaches its trigger, calls the spawn routine the stored number of times.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:65E6
name: tick_burst_flag_and_spawn
description: Decrements the shared burst flag and, once it drops below a limit, calls the spawn routine the stored number of times.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6602
name: repeat_burst_spawn_count
description: Calls a routine once for each unit of the stored burst count, or once when that count is zero and bit four of the input is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:661A
name: repeat_burst_spawn_when_counted
description: Calls a routine once for each unit of the stored burst count, doing nothing when the count is zero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:663E
name: blit_clipped_sprite_frame
description: Copies a sprite frame from a byte-per-pixel table into the screen buffer, skipping transparent zero pixels and clipping the frame against the edges of the drawing window.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:667E
name: copy_sprite_rows_from_buffer
description: Copies rows of byte pixels from a source buffer into the screen, skipping zero (transparent) pixels, with the same edge clipping as its neighbours.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:668C
name: draw_sprite_rows_transparent
description: Draws rows of byte pixels from a source into the screen buffer with zero pixels left transparent, using the same edge clipping as its neighbours.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:66A8
name: copy_clipped_sprite_rows
description: Copies rows of byte pixels into the destination buffer with zero pixels skipped, clipping only against one range check and not against the window edges.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:66B0
name: copy_full_sprite_rows_unclipped
description: Copies the full requested width of each row of byte pixels into the destination, skipping zero pixels and performing no clipping.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6766
name: clear_two_hundred_longwords
description: Writes zero to 200 consecutive longwords starting at a buffer and then clears a shared counter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6780
name: show_chat_mode_message_once
description: When the input-enable flag is set and the chat-mode flag is clear, it draws the text CHAT MODE ENABLED one character at a time, resets four text-state globals and sets the chat-mode flag.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:67D4
name: clear_chat_mode_flag
description: When the input flag and the chat-mode flag are both set, it clears the chat-mode flag's high byte, calls a routine and stores a fixed value in the display register block.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:67E4
name: reset_text_state_and_refresh
description: Clears a shared global, calls a routine and stores a fixed value into the display register block.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:67FC
name: scroll_text_buffer_rows
description: Scrolls a text buffer: for each of several rows it shifts 39 bytes one place left and clears the byte after them.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:680A
name: scroll_text_buffer_from_base
description: Performs the same row scroll as its neighbour, starting from the text buffer's base pointer.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6844
name: map_character_to_glyph_index
description: Maps a text character to a glyph index: letters map to their alphabet position plus nine, the punctuation marks period, exclamation, question mark and comma map to 36 through 39, and other characters map to their digit value.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6884
name: draw_text_glyph_at_cursor
description: Draws a glyph from the font table into the text buffer at the cursor column over four rows and advances the cursor; a space only advances the cursor, and the buffer is scrolled when the cursor passes column thirty-nine.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6926
name: draw_text_glyph_second_line
description: Draws a font glyph into the second text line at its own cursor, following the same rules as its neighbour: spaces advance the cursor and a full line is scrolled.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:699E
name: install_interrupt_handler_and_enable
description: Clears the interrupt state globals, registers an interrupt vector through the operating system library, and writes the interrupt enable and request registers to set up the handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:69E6
name: set_interrupt_vector_and_enable
description: Writes a fixed interrupt control word to the hardware interrupt registers and registers a vector through the operating system library.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A0C
name: send_serial_byte_and_wait
description: Sends one byte through the serial data register with its stop bit set, then polls the interrupt request register until the transmit-buffer-empty bit is set.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A36
name: return_handler_pointer
description: Returns the pointer to a routine so that the caller can install it as a handler.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A3C
name: read_byte_from_ring_buffer
description: Waits in a loop until data is available, then returns the next byte from a 128-entry ring buffer and advances its read index.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A42
name: take_next_ring_buffer_byte
description: Returns the next byte from the 128-entry ring buffer and advances its read index without waiting.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A60
name: store_received_serial_byte
description: Stores an incoming serial byte in the input ring buffer or, when text mode is on, in the text ring as a lowercase letter; when no byte is ready it waits in a loop.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6A64
name: receive_serial_byte_interrupt
description: Serial receive handler that reads the serial data and interrupt request registers, then stores the byte in the input ring buffer or, in text mode, in the text ring as a lowercase letter.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6AA8
name: append_byte_to_input_buffer
description: Writes one byte into the 128-entry ring buffer at the write index and advances the index.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6ACA
name: busy_wait_forever_loop
description: Loops forever in nested busy counts and never returns; the recovered code writes no colour register itself.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6B96
name: apply_relocation_table_entries
description: Looks up a record in a table; when its marker value matches 1004 it walks the list of offsets that follows and adds the record base to each indexed longword, relocating pointers in place.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6BD0
name: call_indirect_init_steps
description: Checks a pointer for a self-match, calls two routines through a stored table, and calls a third only when a flag is nonzero.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6E4E

description: Walks a list of NUL-terminated entries, calls a routine for each and stores its result at the address given in the list, skipping each string to reach the next entry.

name: initialise_game_system_state_repeat
description: Has the same code as its neighbours and performs the same operating system state save and global table setup.

name: enter_supervisor_and_init_state
description: Enters the operating system's supervisor state, saves the interrupt vector base and task state, then runs the same global table setup as its neighbours.

key: gloom (1995)(black magic)(aga)[cr psg](disk 1 of 2)/Gloom (1995)(Black Magic)(AGA)[cr PSG](Disk 1 of 2).adf:Gloom:0:6EFA
name: start_copper_add_int_server
description: Registers an interrupt server through the operating system's add-server call, looks up the CIA-A resource by name, starts the copper list and sets the interrupt enable register.
